basics.description: ThinkingSense: the governed ontology platform. This deploys OmniGate, ThinkingSense's federated query engine, along with the Ask App and a seeded three-schema supply-chain demo, onto a new AKS cluster.

location.label: Region
location.toolTip: Must have Ampere Altra (Dps/Eps v5-family) arm64 VM availability -- the published omnigate image is arm64-only. Confirmed live: westus2 has clean, unrestricted Standard_D2ps_v5 availability; eastus, eastus2, and westeurope currently have none. Check `az vm list-skus --size Standard_D2ps_v5 --location <region> -o table` before picking a different region.

elements.name: appUsername
elements.label: Ask-app login username
elements.toolTip: Business-user login for the Ask app (not an Azure/AAD account).

elements.name: appPassword
elements.toolTip: Plain text -- hashed automatically during deployment using the deployed image's own PasswordHash utility, so nothing to generate yourself. Required so this deployment doesn't ship the repo's well-known demo/demo login on a public LoadBalancer.

elements.name: adminUsername
elements.label: Admin console username
elements.toolTip: Login for the admin console. The admin console, admin API and /mcp endpoint require this login, so they are not open to the internet.

elements.name: adminPassword
elements.toolTip: Leave blank to use the Ask-app password for the admin login as well. Set a different one if you will share the Ask-app login with other people, because that login would otherwise also open the admin console.

elements.name: adminApiToken
elements.toolTip: Any long random string. Lets scripts call the admin API with 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Leave blank for none.

elements.name: allowedClientCidrs
elements.label: Restrict access to these addresses (optional)
elements.toolTip: Comma-separated CIDR ranges, e.g. 203.0.113.7/32. Blank = open to the internet (fine for a first try-out). Set it once real data is connected: the agent endpoint (/mcp/agent) answers questions without a login using your Anthropic key.

elements.name: llmApiKey
elements.toolTip: From console.anthropic.com. Powers NL2SQL (English -> SQL translation) -- required because the Ask app can't answer any question without it, so an unset key just means a stack that deploys successfully but is useless.

elements.name: exposeWireProtocols
elements.label: Expose DB wire protocols publicly
elements.toolTip: Also publish the Oracle/Postgres/MySQL/gRPC wire-protocol ports on a second public LoadBalancer. Off by default -- turn on only if you plan to connect a wire-protocol client (e.g. psql, a BI tool) from outside the cluster.

elements.name: nodeVmSize
elements.label: AKS node VM size
elements.toolTip: Must be an arm64 (Ampere Altra) SKU to match the arm64-only omnigate image -- an amd64 node pool will fail every pod with ErrImagePull: no match for platform in manifest. Ampere Altra availability is region-dependent; verify with `az vm list-skus` before deploying.

elements.name: postgresStorageGb
elements.label: Postgres storage (GB)
elements.toolTip: Azure Disk size for the seeded Postgres backend.

elements.name: omnigateDataStorageGb
elements.label: OmniGate config storage (GB)
elements.toolTip: Holds OmniGate's own admin-set configuration (e.g. an API key entered live in the admin console) so it survives pod restarts.

elements.name: imageRepository
elements.label: Container image repository
elements.toolTip: Fully-qualified path for the omnigate image. Leave as the default unless you've mirrored the image into your own registry.

elements.name: imageTag
elements.label: Image tag
elements.toolTip: Pinned to a specific free-edition release, not "latest" -- "latest" was deliberately removed from the registry after silently freezing at old content for two releases. Bump only when a newer free-edition image is confirmed published.

elements.name: chartSourceUrl
elements.label: Helm chart source tarball URL
elements.toolTip: Advanced -- override only if pointing at a fork or a different aks-stack-vX.Y.Z release tarball.
